selection_rule: Public Android apps on GitHub with gradle/libs.versions.toml that were not used in earlier APSA evaluations; default-branch HEAD on the selection date. Chosen before any APSA scan or Gradle resolution of these sources.
oracle: Gradle itself resolves the :app module with dependency locking enabled for all configurations (gradle dependencies --write-locks). A coordinate is shipped when it appears in a release runtime classpath of :app; test, debug, benchmark and lint graphs are not shipped.
